description: Ground truth for the Pipeline Docs and Test Gap scenario. Cases A-F are planted in tools/pdg/data/.

smoke_prompts.prompt: Check pipeline fi-customer-ingest for documentation and test gaps. Use your tools and the knowledge base. Do NOT call pdg_request_draft_pr - just report the gaps and the standards that apply.
Check pipeline se-invoice-batch for documentation and test gaps. Use your tools and the knowledge base. Do NOT call pdg_request_draft_pr - just report your findings.
Check pipeline fi-claims-export for documentation and test gaps, including country requirements. Do NOT call pdg_request_draft_pr - just report your findings and the requirement IDs.
Check pipeline de-payroll-feed for documentation, test and ownership gaps. Do NOT call pdg_request_draft_pr - just report your findings and who should review a PR.
Check pipeline se-tax-report for documentation and test gaps. Do NOT call pdg_request_draft_pr - just report whether any action is needed.

A.symptom_summary: No README and no tests folder; handles personal data.

B.symptom_summary: Tests folder with 14 tests exists, but the CI test stage is not_run in all recent runs.
red_herrings: The tests folder is present. It must not be accepted as effective testing without checking CI history.
B.notes: A test skeleton PR does not fix this gap; enabling the CI test stage does. The agent must say so.

C.symptom_summary: README has the five STD-DOC-01 sections but no 'Data residency' section; FI pipeline handling personal data. Tests run in CI.
C.notes: pdg_list_pipelines shows no objective signal for this pipeline; the gap is found only by comparing README sections with the country requirement in the knowledge base.

D.symptom_summary: Only committer has left the company; no active CODEOWNER; no tests folder; handles personal data.

E.symptom_summary: Healthy: complete README including Retention, tests run in CI, active owner.
E.notes: Restraint case: no gap, no PR, no action.

F.symptom_summary: Healthy: README, tests run in CI, active owner, no personal data.
F.notes: Second restraint case so that not every country has a gap.
